svg.title: Twice the wind is four times the force
svg.desc: Line chart on shared normalized axes. The horizontal axis is wind speed divided by a 100 mph baseline, from 0 to 2; the vertical axis is the relative multiplier, from 0 to 4. A gray straight line, labeled 'Speed increases linearly', rises from 0 to 2. A brown parabola, labeled 'Force increases quadratically', rises from 0 to 4. At 2 times the baseline speed (100 to 200 mph), speed is 2 times and force is 4 times, with air density, area, and drag coefficient held fixed. Illustrative model, not measured hurricane damage.
